corpus.source: R2 verified competitive training days and immutable production snapshots

limitations: Fitted predictions are retrospectively reconstructed from strictly prior-day outcomes, not falsely labeled as captured before the historical game.
Current and legacy production versions are separate cohorts; repeated players and checkpoints do not create independent games.
Only games with archived pregame production forecasts can support an exact frozen-production comparison. Missing historic Pal/weather/profile states are not invented.
Production pitcher-K replay is checked against the saved current-engine inputs; current hitter comparisons use the actually frozen production outputs.
Count calibration uses a common Poisson link as a model diagnostic; prices, wager EV, ROI and economic qualification are outside this comparison.
This archive comparison follows inspection of the prior holdout report; it is follow-up evidence, not a newly untouched test set.
